description: Saved cart of the declared account holding a configurable (personalized, N variant attributes), a grouped (one child), a bundle (N children) and a simple product with an add-on. Outputs: cart name and each product's name/SKU/values. KB: Product Types.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the saved carts: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minBundleChildren.description: Child products the bundle line must hold (3 in the edit-saved-cart spec)

minVariantAttributes.description: Configurable (variant) attributes of the configurable line, IsConfigurable true (3 in the spec)

minPersonalizations.description: Personalization values saved on the configurable line (2 in the spec)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
